question_cn: 判断一个棋子是否是困子，最关键的检查方法是什么？
question_en: What is the most important way to check whether a piece is trapped?

options.text_en: Check whether it is on the edge of the board

options.text_cn: 逐一检查它所有的合法移动目标格，看是否全部被对方控制或封死
options.text_en: Check every legal destination square and see whether the opponent controls or blocks them all

options.text_cn: 看它的价值是否比攻击它的棋子低
options.text_en: Compare its value with the value of the piece attacking it
Check whether it is in check

explanation_cn: 识别困子的方法：逐一列出该棋子可以走到的所有格子，检查每个格子是否被对方攻击、被己方棋子占据或被兵封堵。如果所有目标格都不安全，这个棋子就是困子。角落和棋盘边缘会减少棋子的活动空间，是困子的高发地带。
explanation_en: List every square the piece can legally move to. Check whether each one is attacked by the opponent, occupied by a friendly piece, or blocked by pawns. If no destination is safe, the piece is trapped. Corners and board edges leave fewer escape squares, so traps often occur there.
